items.label: Stockpile spot size
items.description: Placeholder (R20). The side length, in meters, of one stockpile stack spot.

items.label: Stockpile capacity per quarter
items.description: Placeholder (R22). How many size-1 capacity units one quarter of a stack spot holds; a pile of a size-N item holds this times the quarters its shape covers, divided by N, rounded down.

items.label: Stockpile pile box coverage
items.description: Placeholder (R22). How much of a pile's own footprint (its quarters' area) the placeholder box covers, so spots don't look oversized for what's in them.

items.label: Natural layout patch min size
items.description: Placeholder (R20). The Natural stockpile layout's smallest patch size, in spots per side.

items.label: Natural layout patch max size
items.description: Placeholder (R20). The Natural stockpile layout's largest patch size, in spots per side.

items.label: Natural layout patch min angle
items.description: Placeholder (R20). The smallest random angle a Natural layout patch can be turned to.

items.label: Natural layout patch max angle
items.description: Placeholder (R20). The largest random angle a Natural layout patch can be turned to.

items.label: Natural layout placement attempts
items.description: Placeholder (R20). How many random patch placements the Natural stockpile layout tries before it stops covering the painted area with more spots.
